name: Thoropass
description: Thoropass is a security compliance and audit platform for frameworks, controls, evidence, continuous monitoring, risk, policies, access reviews, questionnaires, trust centers, and assurance services.
agentUseSummary: Thoropass publishes a partner-only integration API program and a customer-success-issued SCIM provisioning surface, but no distributable customer self-service account API for safely reading Thoropass compliance data. Relay mounts no connection or tools until Thoropass approves a partner contract with documented authentication, permissions, endpoints, and lifecycle terms.

blocked.label: Connect a Thoropass account
blocked.description: Thoropass does not publish a customer self-service OAuth or API-key contract for third-party access to compliance account data.

blocked.label: Read Thoropass compliance data
blocked.description: Frameworks, controls, evidence, monitors, risks, policies, audits, access reviews, questionnaires, trust data, and reports remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Provision users or change Thoropass
blocked.description: SCIM user and group provisioning, evidence submission, partner data ingestion, settings, exports, and every mutation remain unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent action can be enabled without a distributable Thoropass partner API agreement and reviewed account-data contract.

runtimeSupport.description: No customer account API contract is available to mount as OpenClaw tools.
No customer account API contract is available to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Thoropass markets its documented API through an integration partner program that requires provider coordination. Its public customer help center documents only a customer-success-issued SCIM 2.0 key for sensitive user and group provisioning, not a least-privilege account API for reading compliance data. No public authentication, endpoint, permission, pagination, rate-limit, revocation, or distributable lifecycle contract supports a Relay customer connection.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request credentials or show Connect. Reconsider Thoropass only after Thoropass approves Relay as an integration partner and supplies a distributable customer authorization contract with documented account-data endpoints, least-privilege permissions, rate limits, secret rotation and revocation, disconnect semantics, and non-production test access.

evidence.supports: Thoropass describes its developer-friendly API and standardized object templates specifically as benefits of joining the Thoropass Integration Partner Program, with provider guidance and approval rather than public customer self-service access.
Thoropass describes its partner API as an auditor-approved ingestion surface for software vendors admitted to its integration partner ecosystem.

Thoropass documents a customer-success-issued API key only for the fixed SCIM 2.0 endpoint that provisions and deactivates users and pushes groups; this sensitive mutating identity surface is not a general compliance-data API.

Thoropass documents product-managed integrations that collect third-party data into Thoropass for monitoring and audit evidence, not customer-authorized API access from Thoropass into external agents.

Thoropass confirms that its platform processes customer documents and employee-related personal information, supporting a critical risk classification and the decision not to infer undocumented access.
